title: Best Credit Monitoring Service 2026
description: Experian, Credit Karma, IdentityForce, LifeLock, and myFICO — credit monitoring compared.
lede: Five credit monitoring services compared by bureau coverage, FICO vs. VantageScore.

sections.heading: FICO vs. VantageScore

credit-karma-free.review: Free TransUnion + Equifax, weekly updates, ad-supported.
